item.title: About Us
item.description: Dakota Pulmonary, in collaboration with Avera St. Luke’s Hospital, is at the forefront of lung care with our new robotic bronchoscopy program. This innovative program allows for minimally invasive, robotic-assisted procedures that significantly improves early detection and treatment of lung conditions. Our Background Deptmer Ashley, MD, is the founder of Dakota Pulmonary and a highly skilled interventional pulmonologist. He trained at The University of Texas and honed his expertise at MD Anderson Cancer Center.

item.title: Procedures
item.description: Diagnostic Procedures ▶ Flexible Bronchoscopy Flexible bronchoscopy is a diagnostic and therapeutic procedure that involves the use of a flexible bronchoscope to examine the airways, including the trachea, bronchi, and lungs. It is performed to diagnose conditions such as infections, tumors, inflammation, and bleeding, as well as to collect tissue samples or remove foreign objects. ▶ Endobronchial Ultrasound (EBUS) Endobronchial Ultrasound (EBUS) is a minimally invasive procedure that combines bronchoscopy with ultrasound to visualize and sample structures within and around the airways.
